exposure: originating from countries where FGM is practiced
cohort: 245 sub-Saharan women and 490 Spanish women who gave birth between 2012 and 2015
finding: Sub-Saharan women from countries where FGM is practiced experienced more birthing complications compared to Spanish women.
mod_finding: The study found that sub-Saharan women from countries where FGM is practiced had higher rates of intrapartum and emergency Cesarean sections compared to Spanish women.
